text: Edna O'Brien's Girls in Their Married Bliss, published in 1964, was banned in the Republic of Ireland on publication. In the mid-1960s it was also denounced, censored and burnt for its frank descriptions of sex and sin. It was the third of her first three novels, which came to form her Country Girls trilogy and were all banned in the Republic of Ireland on publication.
